description: Presidential Secretariat - The Public Security Ordinance (Chapter 40) - The Emergency Regulations No. 01 of 2019 Published in the Ex. Gaz. No. 2120/05 of April 22 are further amended
reasoning: This gazette contains amendments to emergency regulations made by the President under the Public Security Ordinance. It deals with legal/regulatory matters by modifying existing regulations related to terrorism offenses, identification requirements, and prohibited activities. The content focuses on legal framework modifications rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
